correctness.rationale: Eight exhaustive coset patterns give precisely six ordinary commutator words, a seventh conjugated commutator, and one identity sector. Each nonidentity sector has one free variable and bijective two-input parameterization; commutator fibers are invariant under conjugation. Dihedral classes follow from parity-invertible double exponents. Exact enumeration verifies each individual output for S3, S4, D8 and D10.

value.rationale: The new invariant is the complete target-valued ternary associator law, not its known identity probability. It recovers all group commutator word fibers and gives all nonidentity targets explicitly for an infinite dihedral family, enabling class-function and character-theoretic comparisons between group and loop structures.
